## Non-Custodial Solana Rent Claimer

Every SPL Token and Token-2022 Associated Token Account (ATA) created on Solana locks a rent-exempt deposit of approximately +0.00203928 SOL (2,039,280 lamports). Selling 100% of a token leaves the empty account open on-chain with your SOL deposit still locked inside.

* Locked SOL Per Empty Account: +0.002039 SOL per standard SPL ATA (and higher on extended Token-2022 accounts).
* User Payout Split: 95% instant SOL returned directly to the user wallet in the same atomic transaction (5% protocol service fee; 0% fee on a wallet's first claim or active Pro Pass).
* Zero Private Key Exposure: Uses native SPL Token `CloseAccount` (instruction `0x09`) inside an unsigned transaction signed exclusively by the user's own wallet.
* Active Balance Protection: Non-zero active token holdings are automatically excluded from empty-account closure.

## 10-Layer Solana Rug Shield

Before buying any Solana SPL or Token-2022 asset, the 10-Layer Solana Rug Shield computes a deterministic 0 to 100 safety score (`SAFE` at 80+, `CAUTION` at 55 to 79, `DANGER` below 55) across 10 real-time on-chain checks:

1. Layer 1 (Mint Authority): Verifies mint authority is renounced so creators cannot mint infinite supply.
2. Layer 2 (Freeze Authority & Honeypot State): Verifies freeze authority is renounced and Token-2022 `DefaultAccountState` is not frozen.
3. Layer 3 (Top-10 Holder Concentration): Strips canonical AMM LP vaults and flags whale or creator bundle clusters across Top-1, Top-5, and Top-10 holders.
4. Layer 4 (Liquidity to Market Cap Ratio): Detects shallow liquidity traps where high paper market cap masks thin exit depth.
5. Layer 5 (LP Burn, Lock & Venue Trap Guard): Verifies canonical graduated liquidity on PumpSwap, Raydium, and Meteora while flagging manual LP-pull pool configurations.
6. Layer 6 (Token-2022 Tax & Seizure Hooks): Audits `transferFeeConfig` basis points, `PermanentDelegate` token seizure authorities, and custom `TransferHook` honeypot programs.
7. Layer 7 (Exit-Liquidity Solvency): Verifies real quote SOL reserves so buyers have solvent exit routes.
8. Layer 8 (Inner-CPI ATA Rent Drain Check): Detects hidden creator-vault or transfer-hook inner-CPI rent traps.
9. Layer 9 (True Pool Age): Validates authentic on-chain pool lifecycle age against spoofed re-deployments.
10. Layer 10 (Buy/Sell Orderflow Velocity): Measures live 5-minute and 1-hour buy-to-sell pressure to catch active dumps.

## Solana Actions & Blinks (v2.2.1)

* [1-Click Wallet Rent Check Blink](https://rentandrugshield.com/api/actions/rent-check): `GET` and `POST` Solana Action (`X-Action-Version: 2.2.1`) that scans any connected or parameterized `{wallet}` and returns an unsigned base64 SOL rent reclaim transaction or clean wallet verification receipt.
* [1-Click Mint Rug Audit Blink](https://rentandrugshield.com/api/actions/rug-audit): `GET` and `POST` Solana Action (`/api/actions/rug-audit` and `/api/actions/rug-audit/{mint}`) returning the live 10-Layer Shield score, risk breakdown, and safety verdict directly inside X, Dialect, Phantom, and Backpack.

## Developer REST API & MCP Tools

* `POST https://rentandrugshield.com/api/scan-wallet`: JSON `{"wallet": "<SOLANA_PUBKEY>"}` returns empty ATA count, dust count, total reclaimable SOL, and 95% net user SOL return.
* `POST https://rentandrugshield.com/api/build-reclaim-tx`: JSON `{"wallet": "<SOLANA_PUBKEY>", "mode": "all"}` returns `transaction_base64` unsigned Solana rent recovery transaction.
* `GET https://rentandrugshield.com/api/audit-mint?mint=<MINT_PUBKEY>`: Returns full 10-Layer Solana Rug Shield JSON audit (`score`, `verdict`, `checks`, `risks`, `liquidity_usd`, `top10_holder_pct`).
* `GET https://rentandrugshield.com/api/v1/shield-check?mint=<MINT_PUBKEY>`: Developer pre-buy gate returning `safe_to_buy` boolean plus full 10-layer telemetry.
* `POST https://rentandrugshield.com/mcp`: JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP server providing `audit_solana_token_10_layer`, `scan_wallet_unclaimed_sol`, and `simulate_solana_tx_drain`.
